name: Arima Kyouya
source:
Favorite series: None in particular.
Favorite character: None in particular.

Kyouya is a second year high school student and is the classmate of [url=/c75371]Rio[/url], [url=/c77305]Takuto[/url] and [url=/c75367]Azusa[/url], a model student. He works part-time as a salesman in a local market with his colleague and senpai [url=/c75369]Shiori[/url] in order to be able to afford a more powerful smartphone in order to install a new game on it: CUFFS Story's, which has just received a new update allowing players to win the character of [url=/c78244]Mimi[/url], voiced by a teenage girl nammed [url=/c75368]Mitsuki[/url]. It is also at work that he meets [url=/c75370]Nana[/url], a "millionaire customer" who invests astronomical sums in the purchase of virtual currency.
